title: Unit 1 · simple past: Verneinung
rule:
Verneinung mit **didn't** (did not) + **Grundform**:
I didn't play. She didn't go. (nicht: didn't went!)
Bei be: **wasn't / weren't**.

words.s: I {didn't play; did not play} football yesterday.
She {didn't go; did not go} to school on Monday.
We {didn't see; did not see} the film.
He {didn't like; did not like} the food.
They {didn't have; did not have} time.
I {didn't buy; did not buy} a new bike.
My mum {didn't find; did not find} her keys.
We {didn't watch; did not watch} TV last night.
Tom {didn't come; did not come} to my party.
I {didn't eat; did not eat} breakfast this morning.
They {didn't win; did not win} the match.
